description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crimson Kobolds enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
